description: Stimulsoft Reports.NET is a .NET-based reporting tool that helps you create flexible and feature-rich reports for the .NET Framework and .NET platforms. All reports are created in a report designer with a handy and user-friendly interface. Using Stimulsoft Reports.NET, you can create reports based on various data sources, render them, and export them to various formats.
